title: United Kingdom confirms donation of Storm Shadow cruise missiles to Ukraine
body:
On 11 May 2023 UK Defence Secretary Ben Wallace confirmed that the United Kingdom was donating Storm Shadow long-range air-launched cruise missiles to Ukraine. Ukrinform, citing Sky News, reported his statements. Earlier the same day CNN had reported, citing Western officials, that the United Kingdom had already delivered the missiles ahead of an expected Ukrainian counteroffensive.

Wallace described Storm Shadow as a conventional-only, long-range precision strike capability. He said it complemented long-range systems already provided to Ukraine, including HIMARS and Harpoon, as well as Ukraine's own Neptune missile, together with other longer-range systems provided elsewhere. He said that Ukraine had a right to defend itself and that the missile would allow it to push back Russian forces inside its own territory. In his words, Ukraine had a right to be able to defend itself against Russian aggression.

Storm Shadow was developed jointly by the United Kingdom and France. The announcement came while Ukraine was preparing a large-scale offensive, which began in June 2023, and followed earlier Western decisions in January 2023 to supply main battle tanks.
